map.横密 10 针/cm、纵密 14 针/cm → 单位面积针数 140/cm²；线: Wale 10/cm, course 14/cm → stitches 140/cm²; loop 4 mm, tex 18 → single loop weight ≈ 4×18/1e6 = 7.2e-5 g; GSM ≈ 140×7.2e-5×10000 ≈ 100.8 g/m² (with structure factor).
map.纵密由 14 提到 16 针/cm → 针数 160/cm² → GSM 升至约: Course density 14 → 16/cm → stitches 160/cm² → GSM rises to about 115 g/m², fabric denser.
map.为什么是估算不是精确值？: Why is it an estimate, not exact?
map.未计入组织系数与回潮，公式给近似值；精确 GSM 以称重为准。: Structure factor and moisture regain are not included; the formula gives an approximation; exact GSM is by weighing.
map.线圈越长用纱越多、布越稀软；越短越密实但可能发硬。: Longer loops use more yarn and make looser/softer fabric; shorter loops are denser but may feel stiff.
